properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Anthony, 2026-09-16, in his words: "being able to do something like /log-issue. Sometimes in active development of a project, just need to be able to capture an issue that occurred and can come back to it later. Sometimes they are also things that aren't necessarily things that have /root-cause. I don't know if this should be generalized to /capture-something (may not be an issue or brainstorm, etc). Usually these are things that you'd like to follow up on later."

═══ THE INSTANCE, added the same day, and it changes the shape ═══
His words: "I was walking by a beamline and noticed they were having an issue with one of the services (queueservice) that I helped deploy. When I go back to my desk, I just want to go to that project and type /log-issue or /capture-something so that it gets included in the design as something to follow up on."

What this instance says that the abstract question did not:
· IT IS FROM THE FIELD, NOT FROM MID-TASK. He was not focused on another task in reflow2; he was away from the desk entirely. So the server-side refusal ledger (option E) cannot see this class at all, and the "agent forgets mid-task" argument is not the operative one — the operative cost is the walk back to the desk and what the first minute there demands.
· THE SUBJECT IS KNOWN AND NAMED. "queueservice" is a real deployed Component (or a Release deployed to an Environment) in that project's design. So the capture usually has a node to land on — a default subject of the Project is the fallback for the rare case, not the norm — and the door's job is to find that node from his word ("queueservice") rather than ask him for an id.
· IT HAS NO CAUSE YET, and must not be made to have one. "They were having an issue" is an observation. record_finding's root-cause trigger fires on causal language ("because", "the problem is"), not on this, so the existing tool already lets it in without ceremony; the door must not add any.
· "SO THAT IT GETS INCLUDED IN THE DESIGN AS SOMETHING TO FOLLOW UP ON" is the whole requirement, in one sentence: a dated observation on the thing it is about, that the loop later shows him. That is a TemporalFact with a follow-up flavour, surfaced at a boundary. Nothing new in the vocabulary; one new door.

⭐ WHAT HE IS ASKING FOR IS A MOMENT, NOT A NODE TYPE. The record already has the durable forms (below); what it lacks is a capture that costs one word while the person has something else in hand. That is the same finding two earlier ideas reached from two directions — a to-do with no cheap home (2026-08-25) and a failure never revisited mid-task (2026-09-12) — and this is the third arrival, which makes it a class.

═══ WHAT THE GRAPH ALREADY HOLDS ═══
· rule:an-identified-issue-is-enduring-never-dropped (his word, 2026-08-20): an identified issue becomes a durable node, an asked Question with a name, or a computed finding — never only a sentence in a conversation. The rule exists; the cheap door does not.
· record_finding: a dated observation on the node it concerns, one call, and it demands root-cause only when the text is a CAUSE — an issue with no cause offered is already legal there. It requires a subject_id that resolves; the beamline instance shows the subject is usually nameable in the user's words, so the door resolves it by search rather than asking.
· report_manual_work: hand-rolled work with a closed diagnosis. Right form for one shape of issue, wrong for most.
· The brainstorm skill: one Decision at proposed. Right for an idea, wrong for "the queueservice was misbehaving, look later".
· plan-increments: claims the to-do ground and is a delivery ritual (the 2026-08-25 idea's finding).
· req:detecting-is-not-asking: record unconditionally at the moment, invite attention at a boundary. This is the shape any answer here must take, or it becomes a nag.

═══ THE OPTIONS, none chosen ═══
A. /log-issue, DELIBERATELY TINY. One skill, two lines: take the sentence, find the node it names (search_design on the user's noun; the Project only when nothing matches), record_finding with fact_type `follow_up`, dated, the sentence as the statement. No diagnosis, no cause, no node-type question. Surfaced at boundaries (capture-session, an increment close, loop_status) as "N follow-ups never revisited". ⚠️ Cost: a 24th skill on a set already hard to keep coherent; and any follow-up that lands on the Project for want of a match is in a drawer unless the boundary read lists it.
B. /capture-something, GENERALISED — one door, one question ("issue, idea, or to-do?"), then routed: issue -> A; idea -> brainstorm; to-do -> the planned Verification / Capability / Artifact the task idea's option C describes. ⚠️ Cost, and it is the serious one: the routing question IS the ceremony he is trying to avoid — asking "which kind is this?" at the moment of capture is the translation step the 2026-08-25 idea already found too expensive. A general door that asks is worse than three specific doors that do not.
C. ROUTE AT THE BOUNDARY, NOT AT CAPTURE. Capture everything as A, and let the boundary read do the sorting: when capture-session or an increment close lists the follow-ups, THAT is when each becomes a finding with a cause, a brainstorm, a planned check, or is dropped with a word. ⭐ Cheapest at the moment that matters, and it is exactly req:detecting-is-not-asking. ⚠️ Cost: a follow-up that is never dispositioned is a to-do list by another name — the tracker objection that killed the Task node type applies unless the boundary read is real and the disposition is one word.
D. NO NEW SKILL — the tools exist; teach the agent to call record_finding. ⚠️ Cost: measured not to work mid-task, and the beamline instance is worse: he is the one at the keyboard, and what he wants to type is one word, not a tool name and a subject id.
E. LET THE SERVER DO IT for the failures it can see (the refusal ledger, option A of the failure-mid-task idea), and reserve the human capture for what the server cannot see. The beamline instance is squarely the second population, so E does not answer it alone.

═══ THE TEST THAT WOULD DECIDE IT ═══
Write A as a two-line skill and use it for one real week on his work project, starting with the queueservice observation. Count how many follow-ups it captures, how many the boundary read surfaces, and how many get a disposition. If the third number is near zero, C's tracker objection is confirmed and the capture is a drawer; if it is most of them, A+C is the answer and B was never needed.

📌 NOT A REQUIREMENT AND NOT INTENT, his own framing: a thing he does every day has no cheap home, and the question is whether one door or three.
properties.name: DECIDED 2026-09-16 — the tiny version: /log-issue records a dated follow-up on the thing it is about with no questions asked (option A), and loop_status lists every open follow-up at the boundary until it is settled (option C); the general /capture-something door is NOT built until a week of use says it is needed
properties.rationale: Captured under the brainstorm skill, nothing promoted. Kept as its own node rather than folded into the two neighbours it plainly relates to, because each asks a different question: the 2026-08-25 idea asks whether a TO-DO grain exists below an increment; the 2026-09-12 idea asks how a FAILURE survives the moment; this asks whether ONE door can serve both plus the things that are neither — and that generalisation question is the one he actually posed. The counter-argument to generalising (a door that asks "which kind?" is the ceremony being avoided) is recorded beside it rather than argued in conversation, because it is the deciding argument and it would otherwise be lost.
